answer: A concrete defense is bonded admission: every agent locks a refundable stake before joining, and the required deposit scales upward as the network grows. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must sink capital into each one, so a sybil army cost climbs past any expected payoff. Trust flows across a bridge of escrowed collateral rather than raw account counts; honest agents hover near the zenith of reputation while dissent sits on the ridge between, flagged, audited, and slashed if fraudulent.
